Class IntellijJava

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.ToolContext
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.AnahataToolkit
uno.anahata.asi.toolkit.java.Java
uno.anahata.asi.swing.toolkit.SwingJava
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.tools.java.IntellijJava
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContextProvider, PropertyChangeSource, Rebindable
public class IntellijJava extends SwingJava
An IntelliJ-aware extension of the core Java toolkit that can compile and execute a script against a specific open project's classpath (the "Singularity Loop" / hot-reload workflow).

This is the IntelliJ port of the NetBeans NbJava. Where NetBeans crawls ClassPathProvider/SourceGroups, IntelliJ resolves the full runtime classpath — module compile outputs plus library jars — via a single OrderEnumerator query, which the core compileAndExecute then appends to its child-first class loader.

    • getSystemInstructions

      public List<String> getSystemInstructions() throws Exception
      Gets a list of system instruction strings provided by this context provider. These are typically prepended to the conversation as high-level guidance.

      Injects Swing-specific execution helpers into the system instructions, enabling the model to use runInEdt and runInEdtAndWait for safe UI interactions.

      Appends IntelliJ-specific guidance describing when to prefer compileAndExecuteInProject over the default compileAndExecute.

    • compileAndExecuteInProject

      public Object compileAndExecuteInProject(String sourceCode, String projectPath, boolean includeProjectDependencies, boolean includeTestContext, String[] compilerOptions) throws Exception
      Compiles and executes a Java script against a specific open project's classpath.

      The project's compiled module outputs (and, optionally, its library dependencies and test scope) are resolved via OrderEnumerator and appended to the child-first class loader used by the core compileAndExecute.

      Parameters:
      sourceCode - the script source (a public class extending the core Swing tool base).
      projectPath - the absolute base path of the open project to run in.
      includeProjectDependencies - whether to include the project's library dependencies.
      includeTestContext - whether to include test outputs and test-scoped dependencies.
      compilerOptions - optional additional compiler options.
      Returns:
      the result of the execution.
      Throws:
      Exception - on resolution or execution failure.
